# Consumer documentation

[繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [Repository home](../../README.en.md)

This directory is for service consumers in other company departments. All documents are currently unapproved, unpublished authoring skeletons. Open questions are author tasks, not ready-to-use instructions or service commitments.

## Suggested reading order

1. [Service overview](service-overview.en.md): purpose and boundaries.
2. [OLAP Service Spec](service-specs/olap-service.en.md) and [Monitoring and Logs Service Spec](service-specs/monitoring-and-logs.en.md): capabilities and limits.
3. [Service application](getting-started/service-application.en.md) and [approval process](getting-started/approval-process.en.md): obtaining access.
4. [Quickstart](getting-started/quickstart.en.md): first use.
5. [OLAP usage](user-guides/olap-usage.en.md), [monitoring guide](user-guides/monitoring.en.md), and [log investigation](user-guides/log-investigation.en.md).
6. [Usage policy](policies/usage-policy.en.md) and [troubleshooting](support/troubleshooting.en.md).

## Reserved Pipeline locations

- `service-specs/data-ingestion/`
- `user-guides/data-ingestion/`

These are currently empty reserved directories, with no readable documentation.
